title: Subtoken Probe + Regional Circuit-Tier Dashboard Buildout
creator: Aisha M. Carter
description: Goal: Implement a lightweight subtoken-level probing harness and a Grafana dashboard that surfaces circuit-tier behavior across regions for sequence-oriented workloads. Motivation: existing dashboards aggregate at request or token-level and obscure prefix/KV-cache pressure and small-subtoken latency regressions that trigger fanout and cross-region failover. This ticket builds the probe, ingest pipeline changes, and dashboard panels to aid SREs and runtime engineers in catching sequence prefix degradations early and tuning circuit tiers and backpressure thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Subtoken probe service that emits sampled per-subtoken timing (request start, model decode entry, KV hit/miss, decode loop latency) with trace_id and region tags deployed to staging
Ingest transformation that buckets subtokens into 'prefix-depth' cohorts (0-8, 9-32, 33+) and enriches with admit-score/priority and shard_id
Grafana dashboard with panels: per-region subtoken p50/p95/p99, circuit-tier state heatmap, admit-score vs latency scatter, KV hit-rate by prefix-depth, and simulated failover timeline replay
Backpressure tuning doc with recommended hysteresis per circuit tier and a canary rollout plan (traffic % and rollback criteria)
End-to-end test: synthetic workload that reproduces prefix-pressure regression and triggers a visible circuit-tier shift on the dashboard in staging
milestones: M1: Probe prototype and ingest schema (2026-02-05)
M2: Storage mapping and query indices (2026-02-18)
M3: Dashboard panel layout and first-pass visuals (2026-02-28)
M4: Canary in staging + tuning runbook (2026-03-09)
M5: Post-canary adjustments and production rollout plan (2026-03-16)
decisions: Emit subtokens at 0.5% sample by default to limit ingestion costs; sample rate configurable per-customer
Bucket prefix-depth to reduce cardinality while preserving signal for long contexts
Use admit-score as primary correlate for backpressure panels instead of raw tenant id to avoid PII and reduce noise
Store probe metrics in a columnar store with pre-aggregations for Grafana panels to keep panel queries under 1s
risks: High-cardinality trace enrichment could spike storage and query costs if sample rate misconfigured
Incorrect prefix-depth bucketing could hide edge cases for very long sequences (>1024 tokens)
False positives during canary may trigger unnecessary failovers if hysteresis not tuned
Cross-region clock skew may complicate sequence timeline replay

2026-01-28: Probe prototype implemented (local). Captures timings: recv_ms, kv_lookup_ms, decode_loop_ms, emit_time_ms. PR opened #4821.
2026-02-02: Ingest team reviewed schema; requested prefix-depth buckets and admit-score field. Updated PR addressing schema comments.
2026-02-12: Storage mapping completed; defined materialized views for p95/p99 by region and prefix-depth. Load tests show 12% CPU uplift at 1% sample.
2026-02-24: First-pass Grafana panels staged. UX feedback: panel for 'circuit-tier churn' needs clearer color legend and drilldown links to traces.
2026-03-03: Canary run in staging with 0.5% sample and synthetic prefix-heavy workload. Dashboard correctly surfaced increased p99 in us-east-1 and circuit-tier promotion events.
2026-03-08: SRE review: requested hysteresis recommendations and a rollback threshold tied to p99 delta and error_rate. Draft runbook created.
2026-03-10: Addressed storage query optimizations and added failover timeline replay panel. Preparing production rollout plan for 2026-03-17.
